file_insights.purpose: Create locations table with multi-location support for organizations
key_components: Two helper functions: get_location_by_slugs and get_organization_locations

patterns_discovered: Multi-tenant database design with organization-location relationship
Soft delete pattern using is_active flag
Comprehensive input validation through CHECK constraints
Indexing strategy for common query patterns
gotchas_discovered: Strict email and slug format validation
Mandatory foreign key to organizations table
Character length constraints for name and slug

approach_outcome.completeness: Full implementation with table, indexes, triggers, and helper functions

recommendations: Consider adding geolocation (latitude/longitude) columns for location-based features
Implement Row Level Security (RLS) policies for locations table
Create corresponding application-level validation to match database constraints
Add comprehensive comments and documentation for future developers
